description: This Java class defines an immutable event named ThingsOutOfSync used to report out-of-sync things in a search index within the Eclipse Ditto platform. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and serializing to JSON, as well as identifiers and metadata relevant to the event.

classes.name: ThingsOutOfSync
classes.description: An immutable event class representing out-of-sync state for certain 'things' in a search index, with methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and metadata access.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ThingsOutOfSync instance with provided thing IDs and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ThingsOutOfSync object from a JSON representation and headers.

methods.name: getThingIds
methods.description: Returns the collection of thing IDs associated with this event.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the Ditto headers associated with this event.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ThingsOutOfSync with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Provides the JSON pointer resource path, which is empty for this event.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string for this event.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality based on thing IDs and headers.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on thing IDs and headers.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the object.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns the revision number, fixed at 0 as the event doesn't support revisions.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns the same instance, as this event has no revision.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns empty, indicating the event has no timestamp.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns empty, indicating no specific metadata is associated.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the JSON manifest string, which is the event type.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the event into a JSON object suitable for external communication.
